Thanks for buying the Source version of the Medieval Village MegaKit!
All textures can be found inside the Textures folder.

The SOURCE version of the Medieval Village MegaKit contains 
all of the models and project files in Unity(URP), Unreal Engine and Godot projects
with the custom shaders already setup.

Versions used for the SOURCE version projects (anything above these work)
 Godot_v4.3 | Unity (URP) 2022.3.4 | Unreal Engine 4.27.2
